classes.name: WorkerPool
classes.description: Manages background task execution across multiple workers using a BlockingCollection for task enqueuing and a CancellationTokenSource for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: WorkerPool
methods.description: Initializes the worker pool with the specified number of worker threads. These threads continuously consume tasks from the internal queue and execute them asynchronously.
parameters: workerCount: The number of worker threads to create for processing tasks

methods.name: EnqueueTask
methods.description: Adds a new task to the internal queue for execution by the worker threads.
parameters: task: A function that returns a Task, representing the work to be performed

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Initiates the shutdown process for the worker pool. It cancels the CancellationTokenSource, signaling workers to stop processing tasks and completes adding to the task queue.

classes.name: OllamaService
classes.description: This service handles API requests to the Ollama API, providing asynchronous methods for fetching data from the local server.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.signature: public async Task<string> GetAsync(string url, Dictionary<string, string> req)
methods.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to the specified URL on the Ollama API, including optional query parameters in the provided dictionary. Returns the response content as a string.
parameters: url: The path component of the API endpoint
req: Optional query parameters as key-value pairs
methods.returns: The response content from the API as a string

classes.name: MarkdownExtractor
classes.description: [Obsolete] Extracts and serializes code blocks from markdown files into JSON format.

methods.name: ExtractCodeBlocks
methods.description: Identifies and serializes code blocks with syntax highlighting from markdown files located in the specified input directory. Returns each serialized code block as a JSON string.
methods.returns: An enumerable collection of strings, each representing a serialized code block in JSON format.

classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: This class handles asynchronous HTTP requests, providing methods for GET and POST operations to interact with external APIs. It uses an `HttpClient` instance to perform network communication.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous HTTP GET request to the specified URL and returns the response content as a string.
parameters: url: The target URL for the GET request
methods.returns: The response content from the server as a string, or null if an error occurs

methods.name: PostAsync
methods.signature: public Task<string> PostAsync(string url, HttpContent content)
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous HTTP POST request to the specified URL with the provided content and returns the response content as a string.
parameters: url: The target URL for the POST request
content: The content to be sent in the POST body
methods.returns: The response content from the server as a string, or null if an error occurs

classes.name: FlattenAllService
classes.description: Orchestrates the flattening of code artifacts, managing the process from directory scanning to output generation and error handling.

methods.name: FlattenAllAsync
methods.description: Initiates the Flatten-All process, which flattens code artifacts within Git repositories located in specified directories and generates Markdown output.
methods.returns:
None (void method)

Logs progress, success, and failure details during execution. Throws exceptions if errors occur during processing or file operations.

classes.name: ChromaDbService
classes.description: Handles content item upsert operations by sending JSON data to a local ChromaDB instance. Provides asynchronous methods for adding and retrieving content items with metadata.

methods.name: UpsertAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts or updates a content item in the ChromaDB system. Converts the provided ContentItem object into the required format and sends it to the specified ChromaDB URL.
parameters: contentItem: The ContentItem object containing details of the content item to be upserted.
id: Unique identifier for the content item.
